semantic.justification: Existing native browser crypto.randomUUID supplies the original UUID v4 entropy/variant/version result. This platform boundary adds no random algorithm, native SDK libuuid linking, download or WASM generation wrapper. Current main/Worker secure-origin API availability is qualified separately; unsupported platform/fatal failure is not replaced by weak randomness. The built-in crypto.randomUUID API is already used by production BrowserFileDialog, Calc document creation/ODS IO and Writer ODT IO; no application dependency or native generation wrapper was added. Actual Chromium main and DOM-free Worker generate source-format GUIDs and copy64001 bytes through original CopyAndSwitchPersistenceTo into real TempFileFastService, preserve position and open flags, accept subsequent writes and remove the actual temporary file. Original Guid QA and active SAL createUuid_001 pass without a random provider mock. Fatal platform/invalid-target abort and native physical ABI/OOM remain unqualified.
